issue.title: Port the Brush and Stroke Width flyouts and remove the Drawing tools sheet
issue.body:
**Parity unit U11** of the native UI port. The RN app must match the shipping Svelte/Capacitor app.

**Gaps (from the parity inventory):**

| # | Surface | Shipping file(s) | RN file(s) | Severity | Gap | Shots |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 | Brush Button + Brush Menu | `BrushControl.svelte`, `BrushMenu.svelte`, `BrushButtonFaces.svelte`, `InkOrMagicIcon.svelte`, app.css `.flyout-menu` / `.flyout-option` | Button: `RsdEdgeControls.tsx`. Menu: `RsdDrawingTools.tsx` (`RsdDrawingMenu`) | missing | The trigger looks right, but it opens a full-screen "Drawing tools" sheet of text chips (Pen / Crayon / Magic Brush / Eraser). Shipping pops an icon flyout beside the button, with the selected option ringed. | `brush-menu` |
| 11 | Stroke Width Button + menu | `StrokeControl.svelte`, `StrokeWidthMenu.svelte`, icons `line-weight-*` and `size-{brush,eraser,magic}-1..5` | `RsdDrawingTools.tsx` (`RsdDrawingWidths`), `drawing/strokeWidth.ts` | missing | There is no drawer button. The five widths are text radios ("Extra thin drawing width"…) inside the Drawing tools sheet. Shipping shows a flyout of ink-colored line glyphs. | `stroke-width` |
| 19 | Fullscreen Toggle | `FullscreenToggle.svelte` | `RsdDrawingTools.tsx` (fullscreen action), `platform/useFullscreen.web.ts` | looks wrong | Moved into the Drawing tools sheet as an "Enter fullscreen" text button. Shipping uses a subtle top-left corner icon, shown on Android web only. | `brush-menu` |

**Done when:** the RN surface looks and behaves like shipping. The PR shows same-viewport, side-by-side screenshots (shipping web next to RN web) at phone 390x844 and tablet 1366x1024, in light and dark, plus the Android emulator. Every RN-only control in scope is removed or moved as listed. Existing behavior tests still pass, and new behavior has tests that fail without it.

**Order:** Depends on the primitive issues (U1–U7) it needs; build on those components rather than one-off styles.

Shipping is the spec. Read the shipping component first, then match it. The `design` skill names the vocabulary. The parity inventory that produced this issue (2026-10-13) captured screenshot pairs in `/tmp/splotch-parity/` on the build host; regenerate any you need.

**RN-only controls to remove or move** for this surface: see the epic list (https://github.com/KyleMit/Splotch/issues/2690#issuecomment-6147912989).

Part of #2690.
